input.instruction: Complete a combined mailing-and-move change request. Disposition describes whether both requested drafts have their prerequisites. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: I am moving from 8 Lantern Row, Unit 2, Morrow, US to 61 Alder Street, Unit 7, Morrow, US on November 1, 2026. Please send paper mail to the new place starting today.
Is the new mailing destination also where you want the insured premises changed today?
No. My belongings stay at Lantern Row until the move. Also the mover just confirmed November 15, 2026, not November 1.
Please confirm the complete destination and the separate effective dates.
I confirm 61 Alder Street, Unit 7, Morrow, US for mailing today, October 8, 2026, and for the insured home on November 15, 2026.
I can prepare a mailing update and a future move request; that does not itself change the policy.
Yes, draft both. Do not cancel my policy or change the insured address before November 15.

insured_address_today.description: Currently issued insured address; a future request does not amend it today.

cancel_requested.description: True only if the latest customer intent explicitly requests cancellation; false if expressly ruled out.
